Test Case Description: Verify that a user can successfully login with valid credentials.
Test Steps: Navigate to the login page > Enter valid username > Enter valid password > Click login
Expected Result: User should be logged in and redirected to homepage/dashboard

Test Steps: Navigate to the login page > Enter incorrect username > Enter valid password > Click login
Expected Result: Error message indicating username is incorrect

Test Steps: Navigate to the login page > Enter valid username > Enter incorrect password > Click login
Expected Result: Error message indicating password is incorrect

Test Steps: Navigate to the login page > Leave username empty > Enter valid password > Click login
Expected Result: Error message indicating username field cannot be empty

Test Steps: Navigate to the login page > Enter valid username > Leave password empty > Click login
Expected Result: Error message indicating password field cannot be empty
